column1: # Tokenizer rules, highest priority first. Format: NAME<TAB>regex
# {EXCEPTIONS} and {EMOTICONS} are replaced by alternations built from the .txt files.
# URL must END in a word char or one of /#=%- so trailing punctuation ('.', ',', ')') is not swallowed.
# EMOTICON: a family (eyes [:;], optional nose - or one/two apostrophes, mouth of one or more ( or ): :(( :-))) :''( )
# plus the list in emoticons.txt (:D xD -_- :" ...). It may start right after a letter or digit (ALLAH:( meal-_-),
# but must not be followed by one (Catatan:(1), kata:"halo"). GSD train: family 0 agree / 11 disagree, all ;) or :)
# closing a bracket, e.g. '(;)', 'Tamaela;)'; 8 of the 11 were already matched by the old list rule. List extras: 0 / 0.
# ALNUM: one run mixing letters and digits/superscripts (km², M1, 5H2O, 18x). Not Rp+amount: that stays Rp | NUMBER.
# NUM_AN: 1960-an, 70-an (train: 38 agree / 0 disagree). NUMBER also takes dot decimals 3.0, 10.00 (train: 163 / 0).
# CONTRACTION: English 's 'm 're 've 'll 'd and n't stay whole (Rubik's, I'm, don't; train: 15 agree / 0). Not Indonesian
# apostrophes: do'anya, ba'da split (annotated whole in gold: see guideline log). QUOTE_OPEN / QUOTE_CLOSE: GSD's `` and '' quote tokens (train: 59 / 0, 16 / 0).
# PUNCT: a run of three or more dots (... .... .....) or the single char … is one token; '..' stays two dots (annotation_guideline rule 5a).
# GSD train has no runs of 4+ dots (0 / 0), so this only changes informal text; '...' itself is 3 / 3.
# OTHER: catch-all, keep last. Guarantees no non-whitespace character is ever dropped (e.g. '_').
